card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 7.2 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, AK Cep: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 59.5 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 4,036 parsecs away.
